arabic_text: وَمِنْ رَجائِكَ بِما تَطْمَئِنُّ بِهِ نَفْسِي،
transliteration: wa mir-rajaaa-ika bima tat'-ma-in-nu bihee naf-see
english_text: through hope in You, with that which will give serenity to my soul,

arabic_text: وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ بِما تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيَّ مُصِيباتِ الدُّنْيا،
transliteration: wa minal-yaqeeni bima tuhaw-winu bihee a'lay-ya mus'eebaatid-dunyaa
english_text: and through certainty with that which will make easy for me the afflictions of this world

arabic_text: وَتَجْلُو بِهِ عَنْ بَصِيرَتِي غَشَواتِ الْعَمىٰ،
transliteration: wa taj-loo bihee a'n bas'eeratee ghashawaatil-a'maa
english_text: and lift from my insight the veils of blindness!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
